{{Quote|It is not our way. The Counts of Serenno do not complain or cry. We are born to take care of others. We don't expect others to take care of us.|Question as to why he hid from his mother despite his injury, Dooku abruntly counters Yoda|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
A '''Count of Serenno''' was a title bestowed upon the heads of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|149|Counts of Serenno}}</ref> More specifically, the liege lord of all the Counts was referred to as ''the'' Count, Duke or Regent of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]],<ref name="HT2">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 2|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 2]]</ref> with the head of each family bearing the title of "Count" and then the name of their house; [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] being the head of [[House Dooku]] being an example of this.<ref name="Rules">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]]</ref> The Counts of Serenno were properly addressed as "Your Grace" or "Your Highness."<ref name="HT4">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 4|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 4]]</ref> The traditional [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]] of the Counts of Serenno included an elegant dark [[Cape/Legends|cape]] that enlarged the wearer's silhouette to intimidating effect.<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I don't want anyone else dying for me.''"<br />"''Your Grace&hellip; Bron&hellip; sometimes dying is the duty of those who serve the Count of Serenno. As it is your duty as Count to accept it&mdash;and to honor their sacrifice. And&hellip; you're still a boy. Right now, you are to be defended and protected until you can defend and protect yourself. When you are an adult, it will be your duty to protect others.|Bron Dooku, heir to the Count of Serenno, and [[Candra Tymon]]|<ref name="AotE-HT5">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 5|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 5]]</ref>}}
Making up the leadership of the planet Serenno, the Counts were believed to been among the wealthiest and most influential beings in the galaxy. In the wake of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]], the six most influential Counts welcomed [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] to their world, although they did not take lightly to outsider influence in their world's affairs. During the Chancellor's arrival at [[House Nalju/Legends|House Nalju's]] retreat, a group of rebels attacked the Chancellor in an attempted [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]]. Thwarted by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Johun Othone]], the radicals were purged by the Counts as an attack on their guest was considered an attack on the Counts themselves.<ref name="RoT" />

[[File:Dookulightsaberignited-ATOC.png|thumb|left|350px|Dooku, Count of Serenno and leader of the Confederacy of Indepedent Systems, was secretly the Sith Lord Darth Tyranus.]]
Following the death of the Jedi Master [[Dooku's brother/Legends|Dooku's brother]], [[Adan Dooku]] was next in line, but was too young to take the title of Count, so his mother [[Kostanza Dooku|Kostanza]] became Regent. During the Republic's [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], [[Adan Dooku]] and his mother were then ousted by his uncle, former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and went into self-exile.<ref name="Rules" /> Indeed, Dooku had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and abandoned the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and took up leadership of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="EGTTF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> Leading the Confederacy in to open conflict in what would be known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Dooku's reign of terror would bring the iron fist of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] down on Serenno at the end of the war. Adan Dooku then returned and took the title of Count of [[House Dooku]] and Regent of Serenno. Led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Cleansing of Serenno]] saw the execution of the other Counts' and their replacement by more compliant Imperial sympathizers.<ref name="HT2" />

In 3 BBY, Count Adan Dooku was assassinated by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial]] Agent [[Jahan Cross]] disguised as [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. His son and the new count, [[Bron Dooku|Bron]], was too young to be Regent. The leaders of the five other [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]] then [[Dooku regency conclave|met]] at Serenno's [[Great Assembly House/Legends|Great Assembly House]] to elect a new regent.<ref name="Rules" /> They then met again aboard the Count Bron Dooku's airship, the [[Windrunner/Legends|''Windrunner'']], to continue electing a new regent. The four other Counts refused to elect the Empire's first choice, Lord [[Rodas Borgin]] of [[House Borgin/Legends|House Borgin]], and preferred Lord [[Orom Malvern]] as the new regent. Following the kidnapping of the new Count Dooku, at the behest of Lord Borgin, the Empire then decided to send a [[Serenno fleet|fleet]] of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to take the young Count and dictate a new regent, who would be Borgin despite the risk of civil war.<ref name="Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 3">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 3|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 3]]</ref> Following the apparent death of Count Bron Dooku, Orom Malvern was then named the Count of Serenno with support of both the Great Houses, the new Count [[Pero Borgin]], and the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Imperial fleet. The Young Count Dooku was left in the care of Ambassador [[Davim Cross]] to await his return to reclaim his birthright.<ref name="AotE-HT5" />
